messages:
hana_cs: Heads-up: LagoonBio usage dropped ~65% since Thu. Their champion left last week (Dr. Patel). Procurement running a bakeoff with OrchidAI. Renewal in ~8w. Anyone owning this?

mike_se: looking now. any errors or new hosts?

hana_cs: traffic rerouted to a staging hostname per our logs, and embed calls are way down. small CSV snapshot I pasted privately.

frank_support: open ticket SUP-1324 with Lagoon infra team asking if the change was intentional. they said procurement requested a pilot but unclear if it's full cutover.

mike_se: spool shows a recent SDK pin to v3.0 that toggles tokenizer flags -> tokens/request +18%. that could spike their spend and trigger pilot. also saw a spike in 429s from their side on 03-19 11:02 UTC.

jules_ae: suggest we offer a short stability package: 2-week dedicated trial, waived setup, plus an optimization session. I'll draft terms. Can we bundle a tokenization patch?

mike_se: we can ship a patch to opt-in fast-tokenizer and a client-side dedupe middleware. low-risk patch, canary in EU in 24h.

sec-bot: Security package request: LagoonBio requested SOC2 + data flow diagram. Action: security to share bundle.

infra-bot: Incident ICM-2026-334 created for lagoonbio-routing-change. Assigned: mike_se. Priority: medium.

hana_cs: scheduled a 30m call Tues 9am PT with their new procurement lead + interim ML lead. Agenda: confirm pilot scope, show cost delta vs OrchidAI, propose trial and optimization. Goal: get a partial traffic reroute back to us for 2 weeks.

jules_ae: I'll prepare a 1-pager: cost comparison, p95 latency, SLOs, and trial SOW. also include rollback plan and canary guarantees.

mike_se: action items: 1) open PR for tokenizer opt-in, 2) prepare canary plan for EU, 3) capture token delta numbers for the deck. I'll post updates here.

hana_cs: thanks. mark renewal tracker as at-risk: champion left + procurement pilot. update before Tue call. :pray:
